title: A one prompt game made with Claude Sonnet
author: Marpal3
selftext:
Basically a space faring civilisation game made by asking Claude to make the funniest 2D game possible from **a hard sci fi article** that i made few months ago by imaginating a space AI assimilation game.

Article link (neurodivergent gibberish, do not recommend + not required to enjoy the game but i'am sharing it just in case for those interested): [https://medium.com/universe-factory/how-could-a-subterranean-alien-lifeform-develop-space-travel-e5183035e962](https://medium.com/universe-factory/how-could-a-subterranean-alien-lifeform-develop-space-travel-e5183035e962)

**Game file**: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i88SxLgTubnpiIehpWgMpV4OnzCg8ERI/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i88SxLgTubnpiIehpWgMpV4OnzCg8ERI/view?usp=sharing)

I barely had to touch anything code wise. What impressed me the most is not the graphisms (literally a text based adventure) or the front end but the core mechanisms and how *good they are scratching a spot in my brain.*

[It's like a cookie clicker mixed with aliens.](https://preview.redd.it/6g1de5st7abh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=81f6a215d9288bcc7d8a32f7c167d417305b199a)

It's very heavy sci fi and it will probably flop but if you like it, that's not my creation technically so you can share it, host it and do anything with this. **Have fun !**
